title: padus pseudocerasus
intro: Padus pseudocerasus, commonly known as the Chinese bird cherry, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Padus pseudocerasus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use as an antipyretic and anti-diarrheal agent, and it has also been traditionally used to treat fever and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Padus pseudocerasus include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
